turns.text: I was wondering if maybe you could help me with something tomorrow.
turns.zh: 我在想，你明天能不能帮我个忙。

turns.text: I need to move a really heavy bookcase and I could really use an extra hand.
turns.zh: 我得搬一个特别重的书柜，真的需要多个人搭把手。

turns.text: Just for like 10 minutes in the morning around 10:00.
turns.zh: 就早上10点左右，大概10分钟。

turns.text: I'm so sorry, but I can't.
turns.zh: 真的太不好意思了，我帮不了你。

turns.text: I'd love to help you out, but I have a dentist appointment at that exact time.
turns.zh: 我特别想帮你，但那个时间我正好有牙医预约。
